primary_question: Under identical discovery controller-block evaluation events and B=10 natural-archive post-selection, does F1 decrease missed finite-audit-Pareto fraction relative to F0?
alternative: E[MissRate_F1-MissRate_F0] != 0; F1 benefit specifically requires a negative difference
confidence_interval: paired-seed percentile bootstrap 12000 resamples; sensitivity only; not an exact confidence interval
test: two-sided paired within-seed sign-flip on mean difference; exact n<=16, Monte-Carlo 99999 n>16
ranking: discovery-all-256 minmax normalised Linf, then L1, then lexical candidate ID within each natural archive
reference: for each seed, rescore all 256 identical candidates on all separate common AUDIT blocks; Pareto on four empirical mean+0.5 top-10pct-tail risks
critical_limit: B=10 post-archive shortlist capacity only. Native archive storage, computation, and original F1 bootstrap CPU are not equalised.
noninferiority_guardrail: Report F1-F0 false-retention fraction, no acceptance without separate memory/CPU data; secondary not confirmatory
source_limit: Historical TRAIN exposure makes the current old 5 seeds only exploratory; proposed new seeds cannot be presented as an independent blind TEST.
